decisions.previous_assumption: Blocking on critical matches would make MATHA more trustworthy
decisions.correction: MATHA warns loudly, never blocks. hasCritical adds visual weight to READY TO BUILD without gatekeeping. A tool that blocks gets disabled. A tool that informs gets trusted.

decisions.previous_assumption: Routing recommendation display could be minimal — just show the tier
decisions.correction: Transparency is trust. Showing 'learned from N sessions (medium confidence)' and upgrade/downgrade arrows is what makes users believe the system is working rather than guessing. Display is not cosmetic — it is the feedback loop made visible.
